source: Smithers modules the platform split refused with "the type X reads the value X": .smithers/flows/issue-sweep flow.ts (platform code names a private `type Item = typeof Issue.Type` of a private schema that kept code also reads) and flows/sync PresenceRoom.ts (platform code returns a private interface whose field has the type of a private schema's same-name type).
